body.label: Vexel
body.description: Studi0's fidelity-first engine: gradient-aware regions, sub-pixel edges, whole-shape fitting.

upsample.description: Trace a small input (≤ 192 px) at twice its size when its own trace shows a region thinner than 2.2 px
upsample.title: Upsample

detail.description: Colour difference (ΔE) below which neighbouring regions merge; lower keeps more regions
detail.title: Detail

min_region.description: Regions smaller than this many pixels are absorbed
min_region.title: Min Region

gradients.description: Reconstruct linear and radial gradients instead of flat bands
gradients.title: Gradients

layering.description: Stacked shapes in painter's order (seamless, editable) or exact non-overlapping cut-outs
layering.title: Layering

corner_threshold.description: Turning angle (degrees) above which an outline point is a corner
corner_threshold.title: Corner Threshold

curve_tolerance.description: Maximum distance (px) between the fitted curve and the traced outline
curve_tolerance.title: Curve Tolerance

shape_fitting.description: Emit circles, ellipses and rectangles as primitives when they fit
shape_fitting.title: Shape Fitting

refine.description: Render each edge's two shapes and nudge the curve until the pixels match the source (slow)
refine.title: Refine

strokes.description: Recover thin lines as stroked centreline paths instead of filled slivers
strokes.title: Strokes

shadows.description: Rebuild drop shadows, glows and inner shadows as SVG filters instead of banded paths
shadows.title: Shadows

stroke_tolerance.description: Largest error a centreline may leave before the thin region is drawn filled instead of stroked; lower keeps more shapes filled
stroke_tolerance.title: Stroke Tolerance

overlaps.description: Rebuild semi-transparent overlaps as two overlapping shapes with opacity
overlaps.title: Overlaps

body.label: Auto
body.description: Traces your image with Balanced, Logo & icon, Detailed illustration and Simplified, and keeps the cleanest result that is as faithful as the best. Start here.
body.detail: ΔE 0.22 · 3 shapes · clean on 82% of 104 test images

body.label: Balanced
body.description: Gradients, shadows, strokes and overlaps all reconstructed. The most faithful all-rounder.
body.detail: ΔE 0.25 · 3 shapes · clean on 81% of 104 test images

body.label: Logo & icon
body.description: Merges harder and fits whole shapes, for a small, clean, hand-editable file. Best where the mark matters more than the last half-pixel.
body.detail: ΔE 0.31 · 3 shapes · clean on 83% of 104 test images

body.label: Detailed illustration
body.description: Keeps subtler colour steps and more gradient stops, and fits a little tighter. For illustration where soft shading matters.
body.detail: ΔE 0.25 · 4 shapes · clean on 72% of 104 test images

body.label: Simplified
body.description: Fewest shapes; the cleanest on busy art and soft shadows. Skips stroke, overlap and shadow recovery and merges hard.
body.detail: ΔE 0.40 · 3 shapes · clean on 86% of 104 test images

body.label: Flat & poster
body.description: A style choice, not a quality setting: solid colours only, no gradients and no filters. Also the safest file for an old importer. Auto never picks it.
body.detail: ΔE 0.62 · 7 shapes · clean on 77% of 104 test images

body.label: Cut file
body.description: An output format, not a quality setting: shapes that never overlap and no filters, for plotters and cutting machines. Auto never picks it.
body.detail: ΔE 0.35 · 4 shapes · clean on 74% of 104 test images
